core_principle: A retro redesign is a translation, not a costume. Lock one era, inventory the modern site, map every component to its period equivalent, build in period markup, then let a separate auditor grade it.

phases.name: Intake
phases.question: What are we redesigning, for whom, and under what rights?
steps: Capture the target URL or saved HTML
Record purpose: client, portfolio, commentary, or internal
Record audience and deliverable: static mock, live site, screenshots, or video
Choose the asset policy: originals-only or archive-allowed
Note legal context: own brand, client brand, or third-party brand

phases.name: Site survey
phases.question: What does the modern site actually contain?
steps: Fetch the top page and up to ten same-origin pages
Extract navigation, information architecture, headings, CTAs, forms, embeds, and scripts
Extract brand colors and font families from markup and stylesheets
Detect modern patterns against canon/mapping.json signals
Capture tone of voice notes and screenshot references

phases.name: Era lock
phases.question: Which single era will this site live in?
steps: Recommend a preset from purpose, brand, and audience
Set year, browser, canvas width, palette mode, fonts, and layout mode
Copy required widgets and forbidden elements from the preset
Set motion budget, audio mode, and easter eggs
Pull two or three reference pages from the archives for the preset
Decide whether a time capsule story is intended and write it down

phases.name: Component mapping
phases.question: What does each modern component become?
steps: Generate the mapping worksheet from the inventory and era spec
Decide map, merge, or drop for every detected pattern
Cap navigation at five to eight items and plan the sitemap
Plan lived-in details
Write the era copy deck in the preset voice

phases.name: Asset sourcing and generation
phases.question: What images, colors, and sounds does the build need, and are we allowed to use them?
steps: Snap brand colors to the web-safe cube and log the deltas
Rebuild the logo as a WordArt-style or beveled GIF
Downscale and dither photos
Generate buttons, badges, counters, rules, tiles, and glitter with original tooling
Render the click-to-play track
Log every asset with source, license, and era check

phases.name: Build
phases.question: Does the page look and read like it was made then, and behave safely now?
steps: Start from the preset kit and the safety layer
Write period markup at the canvas width
Place every mapped component and widget marker
Wire Safe Mode, click-to-play audio, and the text-only page
Lint after every file and fix errors before moving on

phases.name: Authenticity and safety QA
phases.question: Would a 1998 visitor believe it, and is it safe for a 2026 visitor?
steps: Run the anachronism lint against the era spec
Run the GIF timing audit
Score the 40-point rubric without reading the builder's notes
Check View Source, the text-only page, and keyboard paths
Check the asset log and legal notes
Issue SHIP, REVISE, or REBUILD with rows to fix
